lessons_used: Evidence is still thin for adoption (new_screen, redesign), home (new_flow), and choose_path (reorder) changes because only one test has been completed for each.
Evidence is still thin for finish (new_screen) changes because the two completed tests disagreed after noise correction (+7.7% vs -6.2%).
Reordering sign_in steps was helpful overall, backed by 4 positive noise-corrected tests including 1 win (+8.0%), though no clear effect was seen in the other 3 tests.
Predictions were generally too high across most tests, but were too low for the round 8 sign_in reorder test.

candidates.title: Pet Trait Preference Survey Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a pre-selection quiz screen before pet selection to let users filter companions by trait and activity level.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops off significantly at 60.9% conversion and takes median 89s / mean 1017s, indicating users feel overwhelmed by options without initial guidance.

new_trait_quiz.headline: What kind of desktop companion do you prefer?
new_trait_quiz.body: Select a personality style to narrow down the best pet options for your workspace.

candidates.title: Interactive Onboarding Desktop Companion Sandbox
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro welcome screen into a split interactive sandbox preview demonstrating desktop controls, hiding shortcuts, and chat options.
candidates.why: Multiple support tickets report post-onboarding confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Try interacting with your new pet right now before finishing setup.

candidates.title: Background Pet Preparation Status Stream
candidates.change: Introduces a status stream screen after waiting that actively confirms rendering, trait setup, and file placement steps.
candidates.why: The waiting stage takes a long median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-offs when users think the app has frozen or stalled.

new_prep_status.headline: Finalizing Desktop Setup
new_prep_status.body: Your pet is getting ready for your desktop environment.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a setup status screen after waiting.

candidates.score_note: Home step has long wait times, but new_flow historically reduced conversion (-8.3%).

candidates.title: Late Sign-In Relocation Prior To Onboarding Completion
candidates.change: Moves sign_in screen after pet creation and adoption certificate steps, right before final desktop loading.
candidates.why: Earlier tests show sign_in step relocation post-adoption improves conversion (+8.0% noise-corrected win in earlier tests), letting users build affinity with their pet before committing an account.

guard.reason: Valid reordering of sign in within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign_in is backed by 4 positive tests including an 8.0% win.

candidates.title: Path Selection Card Carousel Refinement
candidates.change: Switches the path selection screen layout to an interactive carousel highlighting distinct workspace playstyles.
candidates.why: Choose path has high mean duration (514s), indicating users linger on selecting a path due to text-heavy layout.

choose_path.headline: Select Your Workspace Vibe
choose_path.body: Swipe to explore how your pet will interact with you during work.

guard.reason: The choose path screen no longer offers adopting and making your own.

candidates.title: Companion Adoption Completion Progress Incentive
candidates.change: Adds an official adoption status badge and step progress bar on the adoption certificate screen.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest step conversion rate (60.9%) and long completion times.

adoption_certificate.hint: Your official pet adoption certificate is almost complete!

guard.reason: Valid addition of a progress indicator and verification badge to adoption certificate.

candidates.score_note: Adoption step has the highest drop-off (39.1%); progress incentive targets the biggest bottleneck.

candidates.title: Pet Rendering Live Tip Ticker
candidates.change: Adds an automated tip carousel and time estimation ticker on the waiting screen while pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Waiting step takes median 201s / mean 2336s, causing user drop-off due to perceived app stalls or lack of progress indicators.

candidates.title: Account Sync Risk Prevention Banner
candidates.change: Displays a visible warning hint on sign_in instructing returning users to sign in with their original provider to prevent pet resets.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or reset after signing in with a different account.

sign_in.hint: Important: Sign in with your existing Google/Apple account to restore existing pets and avoid accidental account resets.

guard.reason: Valid instructional hint added to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Both funnel and 8 support emails confirm account reset confusion on sign_in.

candidates.title: Desktop Visibility & Taskbar Quick Guidance Tip
candidates.change: Adds a explicit hint callout on home_intro explaining how to locate the pet icon in system tray or taskbar if it does not appear on top immediately.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets reported pets not showing on the desktop or failing to open immediately after onboarding completion.

home_intro.hint: Pet not appearing on screen? Check your system tray (Windows) or Menu Bar (Mac) to toggle pet visibility.

guard.reason: Valid guidance tip added to the home intro screen.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint addressing 3 support tickets regarding missing desktop icon.

candidates.title: App Mode Selection Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a high-level usage purpose screen prior to choose_path to differentiate between active companion mode and quiet widget mode.
candidates.why: Choose path drop-offs and long mean times suggest users need clarity upfront on how the app operates on desktop before selecting specific paths.
